# openrouter.ai documentation — Api Reference

> 14 page(s) of openrouter.ai documentation under Api Reference. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Api Reference

- [Authentication](https://openrouter.ai/docs/api_reference/authentication.md): To use an API key, [first create your key](https://openrouter.ai/keys). Give it a name and you can optionally set a credit limit.
- [Embeddings](https://openrouter.ai/docs/api_reference/embeddings.md): Generate vector embeddings from text and images
- [Errors and Debugging](https://openrouter.ai/docs/api_reference/errors-and-debugging.md): On and responses, OpenRouter may include a standard HTTP `Retry-After` response header indicating how many seconds to wait before retrying.
- [Limits](https://openrouter.ai/docs/api_reference/limits.md): To check the rate limit or credits left on an API key, make a GET request to `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/key`.
- [API Reference](https://openrouter.ai/docs/api_reference/overview.md): The complete OpenRouter API is documented using the OpenAPI specification. You can access the specification in either YAML or JSON format:
- [Parameters](https://openrouter.ai/docs/api_reference/parameters.md): Sampling parameters shape the token generation process of the model. You may send any parameters from the following list, as well as others, to OpenRouter.
- [Basic Usage](https://openrouter.ai/docs/api_reference/responses/basic-usage.md): The simplest way to use the API is with a string input:
- [Error Handling](https://openrouter.ai/docs/api_reference/responses/error-handling.md): Understanding and handling errors in the Responses API
- [Responses API](https://openrouter.ai/docs/api_reference/responses/overview.md): All requests require authentication using your OpenRouter API key:
- [Reasoning](https://openrouter.ai/docs/api_reference/responses/reasoning.md): Advanced reasoning capabilities with the Responses API
- [Tool Calling](https://openrouter.ai/docs/api_reference/responses/tool-calling.md): Function calling and tool integration with the Responses API
- [Web Search](https://openrouter.ai/docs/api_reference/responses/web-search.md): Real-time web search integration with the Responses API
- [Streaming](https://openrouter.ai/docs/api_reference/streaming.md): The OpenRouter API allows streaming responses from *any model*.
- [API Versioning](https://openrouter.ai/docs/api_reference/versioning.md): How the OpenRouter API is versioned, what we consider a breaking change, and how deprecations are communicated.
